title: Zesty Smoked Portuguese Fish Stew
description: A hearty, fermented, and velvety Portuguese stew featuring smoky fish, made in one pot with a tangy salsa and finished in an air fryer for a raw-friendly twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and piri piri chili flakes; cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked saffron threads and their liquid, fish stock, and red wine vinegar; stir to combine.
Add the chopped smoked cod fillets to the pot and simmer, covered, until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Finish the stew in an air fryer at 375°F (190°C) for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy.
Stir in the chopped parsley before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Refrigerate the stew for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld and the fish to chill and firm up.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional parsley and a dollop of your favorite salsa if desired.
For a raw-friendly twist, serve the stew cold, without cooking the fish in the air fryer.
